questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}f(x)=x\,|\,x|\text{在}[-1,2]\text{上的最小值为}\left[\quad\right].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：}\quad f(x)=x\,|x|=\begin{cases}-x^2,&-1\leq x<0\\x^2,&0\leq x\leq 2\end{cases}.\\&\text{当}x\neq 0\text{时，}f'(x)=\begin{cases}-2x,&-1\leq x<0\\2x,&0<x\leq 2\end{cases}.\\&\text{当}x=0\text{时，}f'_-(0)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^-}\frac{-x^2}{x}=0;\ f'_+(0)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^+}\frac{x^2}{x}=0,\ \text{所以}f'(0)=0.\ \ \text{因此}\\&f'(x)=\begin{cases}-2x,&-1\leq x<0\\2x,&0\leq x\leq 2\end{cases},\text{当}x\in[-1,2]\text{时}f'(x)>0,\text{即}f(x)=x\,|x|\text{在}[-1,2]\text{上单增}.\\&\text{因此最小值为}f(-1)=-1.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：}\quad f'(x)=\left(e^{2x\ln x}\right)'=x^{2x}(2\ln x+2)=0,\ \text{得唯一驻点}x=\frac{1}{e}.\ \text{当}0<x<\frac{1}{e}\text{时，}\\&f'(x)<0;\ \text{当}\frac{1}{e}<x<1\text{时，}f'(x)>0,\ \text{所以}x=\frac{1}{e}(0,1]\text{内最小值点.}\\&\text{因}f(\frac{1}{e})=e^{-\frac{2}{e}}<f(1)=1,\ \text{所以}x=\frac{1}{e}\text{为}(0,1]\text{上的最小值点，即最小值为}f(\frac{1}{e})=e^{-\frac{2}{e}}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{半径为}R\text{的球的内接正圆锥体最大体积为}[ \quad].

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解答：设球心到底面圆心的距离为}x,\text{则底面半径}r=\sqrt{R^2-x^2},\text{高}h=R+x,\text{所以球的内接正圆锥体的体积}V(x)=\frac{1}{3}\pi(R^2-x^2)(R+x)=\frac{\pi}{3}(R-x)(R+x)^2.\\V'(x)=\frac{\pi}{3}(R-3x)(R+x)=0,\text{得唯一驻点}x=\frac{R}{3}\ (\because x\geq 0).\text{当}0<x<\frac{R}{3}\text{时，}V'(x)>0;\\ \text{当}\frac{R}{3}<x<R\text{时，}V'(x)<0,\text{所以}x=\frac{R}{3}\text{点为}V(x)\text{在}(0,R)\text{内最大值点，最大值为}\\V(\frac{R}{3})=\frac{32}{81}\pi R^3.\text{又因}\frac{32}{81}\pi R^3>\frac{\pi}{3}R^3=V(0),\text{所以最大值为}\frac{32}{81}\pi R^3.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{曲线} \ y = \sin x \ (0 < x < \pi ) \text{的最小曲率半径} \ R = [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：}y'=\cos x,\ y''=-\sin x\,(0<x<\pi).\quad\\&\text{曲率半径.}\\&\text{令}R'(x)=\frac{2\cos x(1+\cos^2 x)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\sin^2 x)}{\sin^2 x}=0,\text{得唯一驻点}x=\frac{\pi}{2}.\text{当}0<x<\frac{\pi}{2}\text{时，}\\&R'(x)<0;\text{当}\frac{\pi}{2}<x<\pi\text{时，}R'(x)>0.\text{所以当}x=\frac{\pi}{2}\text{时，}R(x)\text{取最小值.}\\&\text{故最小曲率半径}R(\frac{\pi}{2})=1.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}f(x)=x\sin x+2\cos x+\pi x\text{在}[0,\pi]\text{上的最大值为}[ \quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：}\quad f'(x)=x\cos x-\sin x+\pi\,,\ f''(x)=-x\sin x<0\,,\ \text{所以}f'(x)\text{在}[0,\pi]\text{上单减}.\\&\text{因}f'(\pi)=0\,,\ \text{所以}f'(x)>f'(\pi)=0\,,\ \text{因此}f(x)\text{在}[0,\pi]\text{上单增}\,.\ \text{故最大值为}\\&\quad f(\pi)=\pi^{2}-2\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}f(x)=x^{2}-\frac{54}{x}\;(x<0)\text{的最小值为}\left[\quad\right].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text{解答: 令}f^{\prime}(x)=2x+\frac{54}{x^{2}}=\frac{2x^{3}+54}{x^{2}}=\frac{2(x^{3}+27)}{x^{2}}=0,\text{得唯一驻点}x=-3. \\ \\ \text{因}f(-3)=27,\text{所以最小值为}f(-3)=27. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {商家销售商品的价格} p \text {与销售量} x \text {满足关系式} p = 7 - 0.2 x, \text {成本函数为} C = 3 x + 1. \text {若} \\ \text {每销售1件商品,政府征税} 2 \text {元,则销售量} x \text {为} \left[ \quad \right] \text {时商家利润最大}. \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答：利润函数} L(x) = (7-0.2x)x-(3x+1)-2x = -0.2x^{2}+2x-1. \\ \text {令} L^{\prime}(x) = -0.4x+2 = 0, \text {得唯一驻点} x = 5. \text {当} x < 5 \text {时,} L^{\prime}(x) > 0; \text {当} x > 5 \text {时,} L^{\prime}(x) < 0, \\ \text {所以当} x = 5 \text {时商家利润最大}. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {某汽车制造厂每小时生产} x \text {台的总成本为} C(x)=\frac{1}{9}x^{2}+x+100(\text {单位:万元}), \text {独家经营}, \\ \text {市场需求规律为} x=73-5p(\text {p为单价}), \text {当每小时生产} [ \quad ] \text {时所获利润最大}. \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：收益函数为}R(x)=px=25x-\frac{1}{3}x^{2},\\&\text{利润函数}L(x)=R(x)-C(x)=24x-\frac{4}{9}x^{2}-100.\\&\text{令}L^{\prime}(x)=24-\frac{8}{9}x=\frac{8}{9}(27-x)=0,\text{得唯一驻点}x=27.\text{当}x<27\text{时}，L^{\prime}(x)>0;\text{当} \\&x>27\text{时}，L^{\prime}(x)<0，\text{所以当}x=27\text{时所获利润最大}. \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{数列} \left\{ \frac{n^{5}}{2^{n}} \right\} \text{的第} [ \quad ] \text{项最大}.
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：相当于求函数}y=\frac{x^{5}}{2^{x}}\text{的最大值点}.~y^{\prime}=\frac{x^{4}}{2^{x}}(5-x\ln 2),~\text{令}y^{\prime}=0\text{得唯一驻点}x=\frac{5}{\ln 2}.\\&\text{易知该驻点为函数的极大值点. 取}n=\left[\frac{5}{\ln 2}\right]=7,~\text{则当}n=7\text{时数列取最大项}\frac{7^{5}}{2^{7}}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答：} \quad f(x)=|x| \, e^{x}=\{ \begin{array}{ll}-xe^{x}, & -2\leq x<0 \\ xe^{x}, & 0\leq x\leq 1 \end{array} \\ \text {当}x\neq 0 \text {时，}f^{\prime}(x)=\{ \begin{array}{ll}-(x+1)e^{x}, & -2\leq x<0 \\ (x+1)e^{x}, & 0<x\leq 1 \end{array} \\ \text {当}x=0 \text {时，}f^{\prime}(0)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{-}}\frac{-xe^{x}}{x}=-1; \; f^{\prime}_{-}(0)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{xe^{x}}{x}=1, \text {所以}f(x)=|x| \, e^{x} \text {在点}x=0 \text {处不可导，即}x=0 \text {为连续但不可导点. 令}f^{\prime}(x)=0, \text {得驻点}x=-1. \\ \text {因}f(-2)=\frac{2}{e^{2}}, \; f(-1)=\frac{1}{e}, \; f(0)=0, \; f(1)=e, \text {所以最大值为}f(1)=e. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text {函数}f(x)=\arctan \frac{1-x}{1+x} \text {在}[0,1]\text{上的最大值为}[ \quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text{解答，因} f^{\prime}(x) = \frac{1}{1 + \left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^{2}} \cdot \frac{-2}{(1+x)^{2}} = -\frac{1}{1+x^{2}} < 0, \text{所以} f(x) \text{在} [0,1] \text{上单减}. \\ \text{故最大值为} f(0) = \arctan 1 = \frac{\pi}{4}. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{原点}O(0,0) \text{与曲线}y=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \text{之间的最短距离为}[ \quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：原点}O(0,0) \text{与曲线上任意点} (x,\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}) \text{的距离平方}d^{2}=f(x)=x^{2}+\frac{1}{4x}(x>0)\ ,\\&\\&\text{则}f'(x)=2x-\frac{1}{4x^{2}}=\frac{8x^{3}-1}{4x^{2}}=0\Rightarrow x=\frac{1}{2}\ .\ \text{当}0<x<\frac{1}{2}\text{时，}f'(x)<0\ ;\ \text{当}x>\frac{1}{2}\text{时，}\\&f'(x)>0\ ,\ \text{所以}x=\frac{1}{2}\text{为最小值点，故最短距离}=\sqrt{f(\frac{1}{2})}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：}y'=e^z=y'',\text{曲率}k(x)=\frac{|y''|}{(1+y'^2)^{\frac{3}{2}}}=\frac{e^z}{(1+e^{2x})^{\frac{3}{2}}}.\ \\&\text{令}k'(x)=\frac{e^x(1-2e^{2x})}{(1+e^{2x})^{\frac{3}{2}}}=0,\text{得唯一驻点}x=-\frac{1}{2}\ln 2\,.\text{当}x<-\frac{1}{2}\ln 2\text{时，}k'(x)>0\,;\text{当} \\&x>-\frac{1}{2}\ln 2\text{时，}k'(x)<0\,.\text{所以当}x=-\frac{1}{2}\ln 2\text{时，}k(x)\text{取最大值，此时}y=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\,.\end{aligned}
